full_judgment: Md Ruhul Amin J: This petition for leave to appeal has been filed against the judgment dated April 19, 2005 of a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No.1910 of 2003 making absolute the Rule which was obtained against the judgment and decree dated February 8, 2003 of the 2nd Court of Additional District Judge, Dhaka in Title Appeal No. 520 of 1999 dismissing the same and thereby affirming the judgment and decree dated July 12, 1999 of the 6th Court of Assistant Judge, Dhaka in Title Suit No. 129 of 1999 dismissing the same.
